item.title: How to Build Your Own Academic Homepage by Hugo
item.description:
About this tutorial

This post summarizes my approach after iterating my own academic homepage several times. It’s targeted at folks who want to build their own academic homepage and avoid looking too similar to everyone else. Some people just write pure HTML+CSS by hand (academic homepages are usually static and not that hard), and some use templates their school provides.

An academic homepage is just one way for others to learn about you — what you actually have to show matters more. This blog is just a quick on-ramp for people who aren’t already familiar with the tooling, so you can spend more time on actual research and projects.
